core_stata_commands: regress
claim_or_design_fit: association; conditional_mean; baseline causal with strong exogeneity
select_when: DV is continuous and conditional mean effect is the estimand; data do not require panel-specific estimator or FE can be included with indicators.
do_not_select_when: DV support is binary/count/fractional/censored/duration and linear approximation is unjustified; unobserved unit heterogeneity requires FE with panel; causal identification unsupported.
mandatory_diagnostics: Outcome distribution; residual plots; heteroskedasticity; influential observations; collinearity; cluster counts; specification/timing audit.
mandatory_reporting: N; coefficients; SE type; p-values/CIs; R2; adjusted R2; Root MSE; controls; FE if any; cluster level; sample restrictions.
notes: Use robust or clustered SEs when appropriate. LPM is a special case requiring binary-DV justification.

family_name: Linear models with high-dimensional fixed effects
core_stata_commands: areg, absorb(); xtreg, fe absorb(); ivregress 2sls, absorb()
claim_or_design_fit: association; panel FE; DID/event study baseline; IV with FE
select_when: Research design requires many unit/time/category/geography/dyad FE and focal variables retain within-FE variation.
do_not_select_when: Focal variable is absorbed; singleton/drop rules alter estimand; nonlinear DV family is required; FE dimension is itself the focal construct.
mandatory_diagnostics: FE absorption audit; within-FE variation; singleton observations; dropped observations; collinearity; cluster counts; leverage/influence if feasible.
mandatory_reporting: N; number of groups/absorbed FE categories if available; R2/within R2; FE included; cluster level; focal coefficients; sample restrictions.
notes: Official Stata 19 supports absorb() for multiple high-dimensional categorical variables in areg, xtreg fe, and ivregress 2sls; use community commands only if approved.

core_stata_commands: xtreg, fe
claim_or_design_fit: within-unit association; causal with strict exogeneity and credible FE identification
select_when: Repeated observations per unit and unobserved time-invariant unit heterogeneity may correlate with regressors.
do_not_select_when: Key regressor lacks within-unit variation; lagged DV/dynamics central; treatment timing requires DID; DV support requires nonlinear panel model.
mandatory_diagnostics: xtset; panel balance; gaps; within/between variation; time-invariant variables absorbed; serial correlation; cluster plan.
mandatory_reporting: N; number of units; obs per unit; within/between/overall R2; unit FE; time FE; cluster level; controls.
notes: Time-invariant coefficients cannot be estimated in FE.

family_name: Panel random effects / correlated random effects
core_stata_commands: xtreg, re; xtreg, cre; xtreg, be; xtreg, pa
claim_or_design_fit: panel association with time-invariant covariates; correlated heterogeneity via CRE
select_when: Time-invariant covariates are focal or partial pooling across units is desired; CRE can address correlation between covariates and unobserved panel effects.
do_not_select_when: RE independence assumption is implausible and CRE not used; causal claim needs within-unit FE; key effect has only between variation but causal interpretation is weak.
mandatory_diagnostics: FE/RE/CRE comparison; Mundlak means for CRE; Hausman-style logic; panel balance; cluster plan.
mandatory_reporting: N; groups; obs per group; within/between/overall R2; RE/CRE specification; cluster level; time-invariant variables.
notes: CRE is useful when FE would absorb theoretically important time-invariant regressors.

family_name: Generalized linear models for nonnormal conditional means
core_stata_commands: glm
claim_or_design_fit: conditional mean; variance-function modeling; robust alternative to transformed OLS
select_when: Outcome distribution or variance function suggests GLM rather than OLS, but DV is not more specifically binary/count/fractional/censored/duration.
do_not_select_when: A more specific data-generating process is evident, such as count, fractional response, duration, censoring, selection, or treatment timing design.
mandatory_diagnostics: Outcome support; link and family choice; residual/deviance checks; predicted-value range; clustering; marginal effects when needed.
mandatory_reporting: N; link and family; coefficients plus marginal effects/predicted values when needed; fit statistics where relevant; cluster level; sample restrictions.
notes: Use as a general family only after checking whether a more specific estimator family is implied by the outcome support.

family_name: Fractional response models for proportions/shares/rates in [0,1]
core_stata_commands: fracreg logit; fracreg probit; glm
outcome_support: fractional_proportion; share; rate_bounded_0_1; percentage_scaled_0_1; engagement_rate; market_share; retention_share
claim_or_design_fit: conditional mean for bounded fractional outcomes; association; causal effect with valid design and pre-treatment covariates
select_when: DV is a proportion/share/rate bounded in [0,1], including valid 0 or 1 values, and the estimand is change in expected fraction/proportion.
do_not_select_when: DV is a count with exposure, a duration, a censored latent variable, or a strictly open interval proportion better handled by beta regression; many structural boundary values require two-part strategy.
mandatory_diagnostics: Support and boundary mass at 0/1; true zero/one vs missing; denominator/exposure audit; link-function rationale; predicted-value range; FE feasibility; clustering; marginal effects.
mandatory_reporting: N; outcome scale; boundary mass; link; coefficients plus average marginal effects/predicted proportions; controls; FE; cluster level; sample restrictions; interpretation in percentage points/proportions.
notes: Use marginal effects or predicted proportions for substantive interpretation. Linear FE/HDFE may be used as robustness when FE identification is central and the linear approximation is justified.

core_stata_commands: betareg
claim_or_design_fit: conditional mean and precision modeling for open-interval bounded outcomes
select_when: DV is continuous and strictly inside (0,1), beta-distributed or heteroskedastic in a way beta regression can represent, and exact boundary values are absent or substantively excluded.
do_not_select_when: Exact 0 or 1 values are common and not handled; denominator/count process is primary; FE identification dominates and beta model cannot accommodate required FE structure.
mandatory_diagnostics: Confirm open interval support; distribution shape; precision/dispersion; link choice; marginal effects; boundary exclusions; clustering.
mandatory_reporting: N; exclusion/adjustment of boundary values; link; coefficients plus marginal effects/predicted proportions; precision model if used; cluster level; fit statistics where relevant.
notes: Do not mechanically transform 0/1 values to fit beta regression without documenting and justifying the transformation.

family_name: Two-part and boundary-mass models for fractional outcomes
core_stata_commands: logit; probit; fracreg; betareg; glm; twopm
claim_or_design_fit: separate extensive and intensive margins for boundary-heavy fractional outcomes
select_when: Many observations are exactly 0 or 1 and these boundary values are structurally meaningful rather than errors or missing values.
do_not_select_when: Boundary mass is negligible or generated by measurement rounding; single-index fractional response is sufficient; boundary process cannot be theoretically justified.
mandatory_diagnostics: Boundary mass; true boundary status; separate extensive/intensive-margin interpretation; model combination rule; marginal effects; clustering; robustness to single-equation fractional response.
mandatory_reporting: N overall and by part; boundary counts; coefficients/marginal effects for each part; combined predicted effects if appropriate; cluster level; sample restrictions.
notes: Useful for share outcomes with many true zeros, such as zero share of AI-generated content or no market share in a period.

core_stata_commands: logit; logistic; probit; cloglog; clogit; xtlogit; xtprobit; melogit; meprobit
claim_or_design_fit: binary response; adoption/churn/entry/exit indicator
select_when: DV is 0/1 and probability, odds, or latent-index effect is the target.
do_not_select_when: Outcome is rare with separation and no correction; FE logit drops many units with no within variation; LPM is preferred for saturated FE and interpretability.
mandatory_diagnostics: Outcome prevalence; separation/perfect prediction; rare events; marginal effects; FE drops; cluster counts; goodness-of-fit only if predictive.
mandatory_reporting: N; positive event count/share; coefficients or odds ratios; marginal effects/predicted probabilities; log likelihood; pseudo R2; cluster level.
notes: For panel FE with many FE, LPM may be a transparent robustness model; nonlinear FE changes estimand.

core_stata_commands: ologit; oprobit; mlogit; mprobit; nlogit; asclogit; cmclogit; cmmixlogit; cmxtmixlogit; meologit; meoprobit
claim_or_design_fit: ordered response; unordered category; alternative-specific choice
select_when: DV is ordered categorical, unordered categorical, or choice among alternatives with choice sets.
do_not_select_when: Categories are arbitrary discretizations of continuous outcome; IIA/nesting/choice-set assumptions unsupported; outcome can be modeled more directly.
mandatory_diagnostics: Category frequencies; proportional odds/parallel lines for ordinal; IIA/nesting for nominal; choice-set construction; marginal effects.
mandatory_reporting: N; category/alternative counts; base category; marginal effects/predicted probabilities; log likelihood; AIC/BIC; assumptions.
notes: Choice models require careful alternative set and alternative-specific covariate construction.

core_stata_commands: poisson; nbreg; gnbreg; zip; zinb; tpoisson; tnbreg; xtpoisson; xtnbreg; mepoisson; menbreg
claim_or_design_fit: counts/rates/nonnegative flows; conditional mean with exposure
select_when: DV is nonnegative count or flow; zeros meaningful; exposure/offset exists or rate interpretation needed; PPML robust alternative for skewed nonnegative outcomes.
do_not_select_when: DV has negative values without transformation; zeros are missing/non-observation; overdispersion/zero inflation ignored; count is censored/truncated without accounting.
mandatory_diagnostics: Zero mass; overdispersion; exposure/offset; separation; HDFE feasibility; influential high counts; variance-mean relationship.
mandatory_reporting: N; count mean/variance/zero share; coefficients as IRR or marginal effects; exposure/offset; alpha for NB; FE/cluster; fit.
notes: For net flows that can be negative, consider transformed continuous models or model inflow/outflow components separately.

family_name: Censored, truncated, hurdle, and selection models
core_stata_commands: tobit; intreg; truncreg; xttobit; churdle; heckman; heckprobit
claim_or_design_fit: censoring/truncation/selection correction
select_when: Outcome is censored/truncated by design or observed only for selected units, and selection may be nonrandom.
do_not_select_when: Zeros are true outcomes better handled by two-part/count models; censoring threshold unclear; no credible exclusion restriction for selection.
mandatory_diagnostics: Censoring/truncation rule; true zero vs unobserved; selection equation; exclusion restriction; latent vs observed effects.
mandatory_reporting: N; censored/truncated/selected counts; main and selection equations; rho/lambda if relevant; marginal effects; assumptions.
notes: Heckman-style models are identification-sensitive; exclusion restrictions should be justified theoretically.

core_stata_commands: didregress; xtdidregress; hdidregress; xthdidregress; regress/areg/xtreg event-time specification
outcome_support: continuous; binary_LPM; count_with_extensions; other with caution
claim_or_design_fit: ATT/ATET; dynamic treatment effects; policy/platform shocks
select_when: Treatment/event timing creates treated and comparison groups over time with plausible parallel trends/no anticipation.
do_not_select_when: No valid comparison group; no preperiod; treatment timing unclear; spillovers invalidate comparison; staggered adoption with heterogeneity but only simple TWFE planned.
mandatory_diagnostics: Treatment timing; cohorts; preperiod support; event-time leads/lags; pretrends; no anticipation; comparison group; cluster level; cohort heterogeneity.
mandatory_reporting: ATET/ATT; event-time plot; pretrend test; omitted period; cohorts; fixed effects; clusters; N/groups/time periods; treatment definition.
notes: For staggered adoption, prefer heterogeneous DID/event-study estimators or justify TWFE assumptions.

core_stata_commands: ivregress 2sls; ivregress liml; ivregress gmm; xtivreg; ivprobit; ivtobit; ivpoisson; cfregress; cfprobit; eregress; eprobit; eintreg; eoprobit
outcome_support: continuous; binary; count; censored; fractional via compatible commands
claim_or_design_fit: endogenous regressors; LATE; control-function causal estimates
select_when: A theoretically credible instrument or excluded variable addresses endogeneity; first-stage and exclusion logic documented.
do_not_select_when: Instrument only weakly predicts endogenous variable; exclusion restriction implausible; instrument affected by outcome/treatment; overidentification rejected without explanation.
mandatory_diagnostics: First stage; weak-IV tests; endogeneity test; overidentification; reduced form; exclusion memo; first-stage functional form.
mandatory_reporting: Second stage; first stage; weak-IV diagnostics; overid/endogeneity tests; instrument list; cluster/FE; LATE interpretation.
notes: Use weak-IV robust inference where available; LIML/GMM as robustness.

core_stata_commands: teffects ra; teffects ipw; teffects ipwra; teffects aipw; teffects psmatch; teffects nnmatch; stteffects
claim_or_design_fit: selection-on-observables; ATE/ATT/ATET/POM
select_when: Treatment is nonrandom but selection on observed pre-treatment covariates is credible and overlap exists.
do_not_select_when: Important unobserved confounding likely; covariates post-treatment; poor overlap; balance not achieved; treatment timing panel design better suited for DID.
mandatory_diagnostics: Overlap/common support; propensity distributions; balance tables; standardized mean differences; dropped units; treatment and outcome model checks.
mandatory_reporting: ATE/ATET/POM; treatment model; outcome model; balance/overlap; N treated/control; dropped obs; robust SEs.
notes: Doubly robust estimators require one of two nuisance models to be correctly specified, not both.

core_stata_commands: local polynomial regressions; graph commands
claim_or_design_fit: local treatment effect at cutoff
select_when: Treatment assignment changes discontinuously at a known threshold and units cannot precisely manipulate the running variable.
do_not_select_when: No sharp/fuzzy cutoff; running variable manipulated; insufficient observations near cutoff; discontinuity not tied to treatment.
mandatory_diagnostics: Running variable density; bandwidth; covariate continuity; donut; polynomial order; fuzzy first stage if applicable.
mandatory_reporting: Bandwidth; kernel/order; local treatment estimate; plot; density/covariate tests; N near cutoff.
notes: Community rdrobust is the common implementation route; ask user approval.

claim_or_design_fit: few treated units; constructed counterfactual
select_when: A small number of treated units face a discrete treatment and a donor pool exists with adequate pre-treatment fit.
do_not_select_when: Many treated units with rich panel better handled by DID; donor pool contaminated; poor pre-treatment fit; treatment affects donors.
mandatory_diagnostics: Donor pool; pre-treatment fit; weights; placebo/permutation; sensitivity to donor exclusions; event timing.
mandatory_reporting: Treated/donor units; weights; pre-fit graph; effect path; placebo distribution; RMSPE.
notes: Useful for platform shocks at market/category/region level with few treated units.

core_stata_commands: xtabond; xtdpdsys; xtdpd
claim_or_design_fit: lagged DV; dynamic feedback; endogenous regressors
select_when: Lagged dependent variable is theoretically central and N is large relative to T; internal instruments are defensible.
do_not_select_when: Instrument count too high; panel too short/too small; second-order serial correlation; weak overidentification validity; dynamic term is ad hoc.
mandatory_diagnostics: AR(1)/AR(2); Hansen/Sargan; instrument count; lag depth; collapsed instruments; group/time dimensions.
mandatory_reporting: Lagged DV coefficient; instruments; AR tests; Hansen/Sargan; N/groups/time; instrument count; specification.
notes: Use conservatively; instrument proliferation can create misleading diagnostics.

core_stata_commands: stset; stcox; streg; stcrreg; mestreg
claim_or_design_fit: hazard/time-to-event; churn; exit; adoption timing; failure
select_when: Outcome is time until event with censoring/risk-set structure.
do_not_select_when: Event timing unavailable; risk set ill-defined; censoring is actually sample attrition; repeated events not accounted for.
mandatory_diagnostics: stset validity; subjects; failures; censoring; time scale; proportional hazards; competing risks; time-varying covariates.
mandatory_reporting: Hazard ratios or time ratios; subjects/failures/time at risk; censoring; PH tests; survival/hazard curves; cluster/frailty.
notes: Can model creator/user exit, adoption, churn, or time to first contribution.

core_stata_commands: mixed; menl; melogit; meprobit; mepoisson; menbreg; meologit; meoprobit; metobit; mecloglog; mestreg
outcome_support: continuous; binary; count; ordinal; censored; survival
claim_or_design_fit: hierarchical variance; partial pooling; random intercept/slope
select_when: Data are nested/crossed and random intercepts/slopes answer the research question or improve generalization.
do_not_select_when: Fixed effects are needed for correlated unobserved heterogeneity; clusters too few for random effects; random slopes lack support.
mandatory_diagnostics: Cluster sizes; ICC; random-effects structure; convergence; covariance structure; fixed-vs-random logic; marginal effects.
mandatory_reporting: Fixed effects; random-effect variances; ICC; cluster sizes; log likelihood/AIC/BIC; convergence; predicted/marginal effects.
notes: Not interchangeable with FE for causal identification.

core_stata_commands: sem; gsem; mediate
outcome_support: continuous; binary; count; ordinal; survival; latent_construct
claim_or_design_fit: latent constructs; path analysis; mediation; measurement model
select_when: Research question involves latent constructs, multiple simultaneous paths, direct/indirect effects, or mediation with valid timing.
do_not_select_when: Temporal order among X/M/Y unclear; causal mediation assumptions unsupported; sample too small for model; measurement validity absent.
mandatory_diagnostics: Identification; measurement validity; model fit for SEM; indirect effects; bootstrapped CIs if needed; MAR/FIML assumptions.
mandatory_reporting: Path coefficients; direct/indirect/total effects; factor loadings; fit indices; standardization; group invariance if relevant.
notes: For archival panel causal mediation, be cautious with post-treatment controls and omitted mediator-outcome confounding.

core_stata_commands: tsset; arima; arfima; var; svar; vec; newey; prais; garch; sspace; dfuller; pperron
claim_or_design_fit: temporal dynamics; shocks; forecasting; aggregate platform metrics
select_when: Outcome and predictors are aggregate time series and autocorrelation/nonstationarity are central.
do_not_select_when: Micro panel structure exists and aggregating would lose design variation; stationarity/cointegration ignored; treatment design better handled by DID/SCM.
mandatory_diagnostics: Stationarity/unit roots; autocorrelation; lag length; structural breaks; cointegration if relevant; stability; HAC if regression.
mandatory_reporting: Lag structure; tests; IRFs/forecasts if relevant; HAC SEs; residual autocorrelation; sample period.
notes: Use for platform-level daily/weekly metrics, not as default for unit-level panels.

core_stata_commands: spmatrix; spregress; spxtregress; spivregress
claim_or_design_fit: spillovers; peer effects; interference; spatial/network autocorrelation
select_when: Theory predicts spillovers through geography, social network, categories, dyads, or platform adjacency.
do_not_select_when: Weight/exposure matrix arbitrary; reflection problem unresolved; spillovers are nuisance better handled by clustering/FE.
mandatory_diagnostics: Weight matrix; exposure construction; spatial/network dependence; alternative weights; direct/indirect/total effects; cluster plan.
mandatory_reporting: Weight matrix definition; direct/indirect/total effects; robustness to network definitions; inference strategy.
notes: Important for platform/category/user network research where SUTVA is violated by design.

core_stata_commands: lasso; elasticnet; sqrtlasso; dsregress; poregress; xporegress; telasso
outcome_support: continuous; binary; count; survival depending command
claim_or_design_fit: high-dimensional controls; post-selection inference; double/debiased ML
select_when: Many candidate controls/nuisance functions exist and causal estimand requires disciplined selection or flexible nuisance estimation.
do_not_select_when: Theory requires specific controls and sample too small; post-treatment variables in candidate set; prediction replaces identification.
mandatory_diagnostics: Candidate variable timing; folds/seeds; tuning; selected controls; cross-fitting; post-selection inference; nuisance performance.
mandatory_reporting: Estimator; tuning/folds/seed; selected controls; target parameter; nuisance learners; robustness to seeds/learners.
notes: Use as complement to theory-driven control strategy, not as replacement for identification.

core_stata_commands: bayes:; bayesmh; fmm:; gsem, lclass()
outcome_support: continuous; binary; count; ordinal; categorical; censored; survival
claim_or_design_fit: prior information; posterior uncertainty; unobserved heterogeneity; latent classes
select_when: Research question involves latent types, mixture distributions, priors, or hierarchical posterior inference.
do_not_select_when: No substantive latent-class theory; model only used to search heterogeneity; convergence/identification weak.
mandatory_diagnostics: Priors; MCMC convergence; effective sample size; posterior predictive checks; class number selection; local maxima.
mandatory_reporting: Priors; posterior summaries; convergence; class probabilities; AIC/BIC for mixtures; substantive class interpretation.
notes: Use cautiously for main hypothesis tests unless theory supports latent heterogeneity.

family_name: Official causal mediation analysis with one mediator
core_stata_commands: mediate; estat cde; estat proportion; estat rr; estat or; estat irr; estat effectsplot; predict
community_or_optional_commands: paramed; medeff; sgmediation only with explicit user approval and citation
outcome_support: continuous; binary; count; nonnegative via expmean; supported linear/logit/probit/poisson/exponential-mean outcome models
claim_or_design_fit: causal mediation; natural indirect effect; natural direct effect; total effect; controlled direct effect; proportion mediated
select_when: One observed mediator is theorized after treatment and before outcome; treatment is binary, multivalued, or continuous; outcome and mediator support are compatible with mediate; causal mediation assumptions are defensible; FE/HDFE structure is not central or can be handled through included covariates with caution.
do_not_select_when: Mediator timing is invalid; mediator or outcome support unsupported; mediator-outcome confounding plan is missing; treatment-induced mediator-outcome confounder is likely; essential unit/time/dyad FE cannot be accommodated; user Stata version lacks mediate.
mandatory_diagnostics: Treatment-mediator-outcome timing; outcome and mediator support; treatment support and control value; confounder audit for treatment-outcome, treatment-mediator, mediator-outcome paths; overlap/support; treatment-mediator interaction decision; VCE/cluster feasibility; auxiliary equations; sensitivity/robustness plan.
mandatory_reporting: N; treatment type and control level; outcome model; mediator model; covariates in each equation; VCE/cluster; NIE/NDE/TE and optionally PNIE/TNDE/POM/CDE/proportion mediated; effect scale; assumptions; robustness checks.
notes: Use only when the goal is a causal mediation decomposition, not merely mechanism evidence.

family_name: Official causal mediation analysis with two mediators
core_stata_commands: mediate with two mediators; options parallel; sequential; tinteraction; minteraction; meqtinteraction; mseffects(); estat cde
community_or_optional_commands: advanced user-written mediation commands only with approval
outcome_support: documented two-mediator support: continuous outcome and continuous mediators; binary or continuous treatment where available
claim_or_design_fit: parallel mediation; sequential mediation; path-specific effects; mediator-specific natural effects; CDE; total effect decomposition
select_when: Two mediators are focal; their relationship is theoretically parallel or sequential; StataNow two-mediator mediate is available; documented support matches outcome, mediators, and treatment; causal mediation assumptions are defensible.
do_not_select_when: More than two mediators are required; mediator order is unclear; user Stata version does not include StataNow two-mediator mediation; outcome/mediator support is unsupported; panel FE/HDFE are essential.
mandatory_diagnostics: Mediator count and ordering; parallel vs sequential decision; support of outcome/mediators/treatment; interaction decision; confounder audit for all mediator paths; sensitivity analysis for sequential mediation where available; VCE/cluster feasibility.
mandatory_reporting: N; mediation type; mediator order; NDE/NIE/TE and path-specific or mediator-specific effects; CDE if used; interaction options; covariates in each equation; VCE/cluster; StataNow/version note.
notes: Feature availability depends on current StataNow/Stata version. Codex must ask the user to confirm Stata version before recommending as primary.

family_name: SEM path-analysis mediation and latent-construct mediation
core_stata_commands: sem; estat teffects where applicable; estat gof; estat mindices; nlcom; testnl; predict
community_or_optional_commands: medsem only with explicit user approval
outcome_support: continuous observed outcomes; linear measurement models; latent constructs with continuous indicators; summary-statistics data where appropriate
claim_or_design_fit: linear mediation; path analysis; latent construct mediation; measurement model; direct and indirect effects; group invariance
select_when: Theory requires latent constructs, measurement validation, multiple indicators, direct/indirect path coefficients, SEM fit indices, or multiple-group path constraints; linear SEM assumptions are appropriate.
do_not_select_when: Outcome/mediator requires nonlinear response that sem cannot represent; model is unidentified; causal mediation assumptions are not defensible but causal decomposition language is planned; high-dimensional FE are central.
mandatory_diagnostics: SEM identification; measurement reliability/validity; fit indices; residual/covariance diagnostics; modification indices used only with theory; direct/indirect effect computation; cluster/robust VCE feasibility; missing data/FIML plan.
mandatory_reporting: Path coefficients; direct/indirect/total effects; factor loadings; fit indices; standardized/unstandardized estimates; measurement model; identification notes; group invariance if applicable.
notes: Appropriate for theory-driven path and measurement models; causal language requires additional assumptions beyond SEM fit.

family_name: GSEM generalized, nonlinear, and multilevel mediation/path models
core_stata_commands: gsem; nlcom; testnl; margins; predict; estat ic
outcome_support: continuous; binary; count; ordinal; nominal; censored; fractional beta; survival; latent variables; mixed response families
data_structure: cross_section; multilevel; nested; crossed; panel_with_random_effects; generalized_path_model
claim_or_design_fit: generalized path mediation; nonlinear mediation; multilevel mediation; random-intercept/slope mediation; latent generalized mediation
select_when: Outcome or mediator requires generalized links, multilevel random effects, mixed response families, latent variables at different levels, or multilevel mediation not representable in sem.
do_not_select_when: Natural direct/indirect causal effects are required but not identified by the specified gsem estimands; convergence or identification is weak; fixed effects/HDFE are essential and not represented.
mandatory_diagnostics: Model identification; response-family/link support; convergence; starting values; random-effect structure; cluster sizes; indirect effect computation; marginal-effect scale; robustness to link and random-effects specifications.
mandatory_reporting: Equation list; link/family for each equation; path coefficients; indirect/path effects via nlcom or simulation; marginal effects/predictions where needed; random-effect variances; convergence; information criteria.
notes: Often useful for multilevel mediation, but indirect effects in nonlinear models require careful scale-specific interpretation.

family_name: Sequential-equation mechanism analysis with optional product-of-coefficients
core_stata_commands: regress; areg; xtreg; reghdfe if approved; logit; probit; poisson; nbreg; glm; nlcom; suest; bootstrap
community_or_optional_commands: reghdfe; ppmlhdfe; ivreghdfe; medsem; sgmediation; khb only with explicit approval
outcome_support: depends on base model family; continuous; binary; count; fractional; bounded; panel outcomes as supported by equation-specific estimator
data_structure: panel; HDFE; dyadic_panel; event_time_panel; cross_section; repeated_cross_section
claim_or_design_fit: mechanism evidence; exploratory mediation; robustness path decomposition; panel/HDFE-compatible sequential models
select_when: Panel FE, HDFE, DID/event-time, dyadic FE, or equation-specific estimators are essential and official mediate/SEM/GSEM cannot represent the required identification strategy; the manuscript can frame results as mechanism evidence or conditional mediation with clearly stated limits.
do_not_select_when: The manuscript requires formal natural direct/indirect causal effects and causal mediation assumptions are not addressed; mediator is used as a bad control in total-effect model; nonlinear products are interpreted without scale caution.
mandatory_diagnostics: Timing and bad-control audit; equation-specific diagnostics; common sample across mediator and outcome equations; FE absorption; cluster consistency; bootstrap/suest feasibility; indirect-effect scale; alternative mediator timing.
mandatory_reporting: Separate mediator and outcome equations; total-effect model without mediator; direct-effect-with-mediator model only as mechanism specification; product or path effect with CI if estimated; clear label as mechanism evidence unless causal assumptions are defended.
notes: This is often the most practical route for archival IS panel data, but Codex must not overstate causal mediation.
